'''Juleson''' is a graduating male student NPC from [[New Federation]], found talking about his graduation plans with his classmate from Huanglong, '''Jiushao'''.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Juleson:''' Any idea where you're heading after graduation?
:'''Jiushao:''' [[Huaxu Academy]]. With warning signs of a Threnodian revival in [[Jinzhou]], every city-state in Huanglong is speeding up its military R&D. My country needs me now more than ever. What's your plan?
:'''Juleson:''' Same idea, heading back to the New Fed. Got a position at [[Harmoway Medicine]]. Who knows... maybe next time we meet, we'll be on opposite sides.
:'''Jiushao:''' Hard to say. At least in the fight against the Lament, we'll always stand together.
:'''Juleson:''' Heh... I hope to see you and your work at next year's [[World Expo]].
:'''Jiushao:''' You will, I promise. Take care of yourself, my friend.
:'''Juleson:''' You too, old buddy.
{{Dialogue End}}
